blocks.title: Living things
blocks.md: **Living things** grow, eat or drink, move and have babies. People, animals and plants are living things.

blocks.caption: Living and non-living things.
blocks.alt: Six boxes: boy, hen, mango tree as living; chair, stone, ball as non-living.

blocks.title: Non-living things
blocks.md: **Non-living things** do not grow or eat. A stone, a table, a cup and water are non-living things. A dead leaf is not alive any more.

blocks.title: Common mistakes
blocks.md:
- A tree is alive, even if it does not walk.
- A car moves, but it is not alive.
- Seeds are alive and can grow.

blocks.title: Example 1
blocks.statement: Is a goat living or non-living?

blocks.title: Example 2
blocks.statement: Is a stone living or non-living?
steps: A stone does not eat or grow.

blocks.title: Parts of the body
blocks.md: The head has the eyes, ears, nose and mouth. We have two arms, two hands, two legs and two feet. We have 10 fingers and 10 toes.

blocks.caption: What the body parts do.
blocks.alt: Four boxes: eyes see, ears hear, nose smells, mouth eats.

blocks.title: What parts do
blocks.md: Eyes see. Ears hear. The nose smells. The mouth eats and speaks. Hands hold things. Legs help us walk and run.

blocks.title: Common mistakes
blocks.md:
- We see with eyes, not with ears.
- Each hand has 5 fingers.
- Take care of every part of the body.

blocks.title: Example 1
blocks.statement: How many fingers on two hands?

blocks.title: Example 2
blocks.statement: Which part do we use to hear?
steps: The ears are on the sides of the head.

blocks.caption: Five senses.
blocks.alt: Five yellow stars for the five senses.

blocks.title: Use them
blocks.md: We see a colour. We hear a drum. We smell a flower. We taste a sweet mango. We feel that ice is cold.

blocks.title: Common mistakes
blocks.md:
- Do not taste things that you do not know.
- Never smell strong chemicals.
- Touch only safe things, not hot things or sharp things.

blocks.title: Example 1
blocks.statement: Which sense do we use to listen to music?

blocks.title: Example 2
blocks.statement: Which sense tells us that a mango is sweet?
steps: It is the sense of taste.

Syllabus references, scope and level of difficulty are to be checked against the official text; all facts, formulas and worked examples to be verified by a teacher before release.

blocks.title: Parts of a plant
blocks.md: A plant has **roots**, a **stem**, **leaves** and often **flowers**. Roots are in the soil. The stem holds the plant up. The leaves are green.

blocks.caption: A simple plant.
blocks.alt: A plant with a flower, leaves, a stem and roots in the soil.

blocks.title: Jobs
blocks.md: Roots take in water from the soil. The stem carries water up. Leaves help the plant make food from light. Flowers can turn into fruits with seeds.

blocks.title: Common mistakes
blocks.md:
- Roots are usually under the ground.
- Not all plants have flowers all year.
- A plant needs water to live.

blocks.title: Example 1
blocks.statement: Which part of a plant is in the soil?
steps: The plant takes water from the soil.
The roots are in the soil.

Say how animals move and where they live.
reviewNotes: Elementary science content is kept to very simple, well-known facts; to be reviewed by a primary teacher.

blocks.title: Kinds of animals
blocks.md: **Pets** live with us: a dog, a cat. **Farm animals** give us food: a hen, a goat, a cow. **Wild animals** live in the forest or bush: a monkey, an elephant, a lion.

blocks.caption: How animals move.
blocks.alt: Four boxes: bird flies, fish swims, snake crawls, dog runs.

blocks.title: How animals move
blocks.md: Birds **fly**. Fish **swim**. Snakes **crawl**. Dogs and goats **walk and run**. Frogs **hop** and swim.

blocks.title: Common mistakes
blocks.md:
- Do not touch wild animals.
- Animals need food, water and a home.
- A bat can fly, but it is not a bird.

blocks.title: Example 1
blocks.statement: Name a farm animal that gives eggs.
steps: A hen is a farm animal.
